decisions.convention: Keep individual close rows and journals; report both raw row count and scorer-key aggregates. Aggregate equality cannot prove per-item completeness.
decisions.acceptance: Comparator reports item differences and aggregate differences independently; no row is silently deduplicated

evidence: score.py task score functions and je_match
decisions.convention: Public score is preserved. The comparator reports, separately from the score: AP document_type/action/currency and journal presence; AR invoice date/currency/deductions; cash residual invoice; bank adjustment category and company; IC amount/responsible; close rows and journal presence; entry rules via validate_entry; posting dates outside the close month; unknown entity ids. Balance dimensions beyond company/account (partner, cost object) are not compared.
decisions.acceptance: Remaining: compare balance dimensions beyond company/account

decisions.convention: The comparator raises COMPANY_MISMATCH for a wrong company at row, entry or line level, even when je_match accepts the journal. Public scorer remains unchanged.
decisions.acceptance: Demonstrated with a wrong-company run: score unchanged, diagnostic raised. A committed negative fixture is not added.

evidence: roadmap audit: synthetic identifiers are not production tax identities
decisions.convention: Preserve raw NIF and use master/source identity correspondence. Do not reject a synthetic tax identity merely because a production checksum fails; recipient NIF presence and addressee identity remain required policy checks.
decisions.acceptance: Document facts retain literal NIF and provenance; no normalization overwrites source evidence
